verdict.rationale: Delegating to a built-in AI is Lovable's core interaction. Build mode is documented as an autonomous agent that 'takes ownership of execution end to end', accepts steering follow-ups mid-task, shows file diffs and summaries, spawns read-only subagents, reuses workspace skills, and runs project actions like publishing or finding a domain from chat. Hands-on users confirm delegated building works for scaffolding and internal tools, though some report weak structure on more complex work. Missing for 10: independent evidence that delegated execution stays reliable on complex, multi-part tasks (hands-on reports note one-file sprawl and poorly architected output).
